bio: Close to the Mariahilfer Straße shopping drag, on the seventh floor of the chic MOTTO boutique hotel, this restaurant has really distinctive architecture. The tasteful upscale interior will appeal to diners, as will the pleasantly lounge-like atmosphere. Be sure to check out the interesting bar too. The food is uncomplicated and unpretentious. Try the bouillabaisse – one of the classics! – and don't forgo the apricot dumplings. One floor up is the rooftop terrace, which boasts a magnificent view, and, although it only serves a smaller menu, is nonetheless the place to be!...
